name: danny-skills
description: Personal skill pack. Pipeline: dt-plan -> dt-visualize-plan -> optional dt-prototype -> dt-review -> dt-roadmap -> dt-build, with dt-visualize-design rendering finalized designs. Authoring: dt-tune (approval-gated SKILL.md amendments). Session hygiene: dt-session-audit (autonomous end-of-session capture across CLAUDE.md / MEMORY.md / CONTEXT.md / glossary.md), dt-memory-hygiene (periodic bloat cleanup), dt-handoff (single-use session continuity). Workstation: dt-app-launcher (hardened local GUI launchers), dt-terminal-format-profile (deterministic VS Code terminal colors). Writing: dt-writing-draft and dt-writing-edit (sourced drafting and editing for letters, papers, copy). Git: git-sync-features, git-merge-feature (rebase-forward feature workflow).

changelog: 0.9.21 dt-roadmap-acceptance-gate-compatibility: dt-roadmap (v1.0.1 -> v1.1.0) hardened so its output is structurally compatible with dt-build's per-milestone acceptance gate. Closes the producer/consumer drift surfaced on 2026-05-27: dt-build v2.3.0 added a gate that hard-rejects any verification-manifest cell that doesn't name a runnable artifact, but dt-roadmap was never updated, so its deterministic producer emitted roadmaps that the gate blocked on every milestone with 'roadmap verification check names no concrete test file or command.' Three coordinated layer changes. (1) Schema (skills/dt-roadmap/references/roadmap-schema.md): producer_current_version 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0; added VERIFICATION_NAMES_NO_RUNNABLE error code and a canonical 'runnable artifact' definition mirroring the dt-build extractor. schema_version stays at major 1 (additive enforcement). (2) Validator (skills/dt-roadmap/scripts/roadmap-validator.ps1): now dot-sources repo-level scripts/extract-named-artifacts.ps1 (byte-identical to the inline Extract-NamedArtifacts function inside skills/dt-build/scripts/verify-milestone-acceptance.ps1; dt-build's inline copy is annotated with the cross-pointer but otherwise unchanged); fails closed with VERIFICATION_NAMES_NO_RUNNABLE per milestone when the combined acceptance-checks + matching verification procedure surface names nothing runnable. (3) Producer (skills/dt-roadmap/scripts/build-roadmap.ps1): primary input parser now derives milestones from a `## Implementation Sequence` (or `Implementation Order` / `Build Sequence` / `Build Order` / `Milestone Sequence`) section's enumerated top-level numbered list (legacy `### Phase ...` parsing kept as back-compat fallback); concrete pytest/python commands are lifted verbatim from milestone-tagged bullets in `## Validation Gates` (convention `- M<NN>: ... `cmd``) into procedure cells, replacing the prior stub prose ('Run acceptance checks for M01 and capture PASS/FAIL evidence.') that could never satisfy the gate. Producer surfaces any milestone without a lifted command in a new `## Producer Warnings` section so the validator's hard-fail is predictable. Regression-tested against the hand-edited db-durability roadmap (PASSes validator) and a fresh regeneration from db-durability/design-final.md (PASSes validator; dt-build gate then reports each milestone as PASS or BLOCKED with specific 'named artifact missing' blockers — the bug blocker is eliminated from every possible producer output).

0.9.20 dt-build-acceptance-gate-fixes: dt-build (v2.3.0 -> v2.3.1) patches two contract-completeness issues surfaced by the 2026-05-27 Codex rebuild of the file-sorter learning loop. (1) verify-milestone-acceptance.ps1 now transforms `pytest ...` to `python -m pytest ...` before subprocess invocation so `pwsh -NoProfile` (which strips the user's venv Scripts/ from PATH) finds the test runner -- previously every milestone whose verification check used the roadmap's `pytest` convention false-BLOCKED even when the tests passed when run directly. (2) build-acceptance-ledger.ps1 now reads `downgrade_approved_by: <upn>` markers from the run folder's build-decision-log.md per milestone via a new Parse-ApprovalSection helper; BLOCKED rows with an approval flip to a new third status `APPROVED_DOWNGRADE` and surface the rationale + originally-blocked items as Notes annotations. Wires the approval mechanism the acceptance-contract.md already documented but did not previously have machinery behind. APPROVED_DOWNGRADE is its own status (not PASS) so the audit trail stays visible -- a build with one APPROVED_DOWNGRADE row is shipped-with-receipts; a build with even one BLOCKED row is not shipped. Approval does not cascade to dependent milestones (each runs on its own merits).

0.9.19 dt-build-acceptance-contract-gate: dt-build (v2.2.0 -> v2.3.0) now enforces a per-milestone verify-before-complete acceptance contract instead of verify-at-end. New reference: skills/dt-build/references/acceptance-contract.md (the binding contract — quote verification check, build chunk, run named pytest/script command, scan for downgrade language, append acceptance row, only then advance). New scripts: skills/dt-build/scripts/verify-milestone-acceptance.ps1 (extracts artifacts the roadmap names per milestone, checks presence in the working tree, with -RunTests runs named pytest/python commands and folds exit codes into PASS/BLOCKED verdict), skills/dt-build/scripts/check-downgrade-language.ps1 (banned-phrase scanner calibrated against the 2026-05-27 file-sorter learning-loop post-mortem; flags 'compatible fallback', 'deterministic fallback', 'hash fallback', 'production can replace', 'scaffold implementation', 'verifier passes' paired with artifact-missing context, etc., with downgrade_approved_by: danny block override), skills/dt-build/scripts/identify-load-bearing.ps1 (parses roadmap, flags milestones whose name/acceptance/verification text contains load-bearing / gate / publish / persistence / runtime-flip / E2E / critical-path triggers; build orders these first within their DAG layer), skills/dt-build/scripts/build-acceptance-ledger.ps1 (aggregates per-milestone results into build-acceptance-ledger.md + build-acceptance-ledger.html with the four-axis split: implemented / tested / accepted / status, plus blockers and downgrade-language matches). The ledger replaces the freeform build summary as the build's final answer. Closes the failure class where a build is reported complete while load-bearing E2E coverage, named integration hooks, real model artifacts, and state-machine guards are missing or substituted with placeholders that satisfy thinner tests.

0.9.18 determinism-composability-extractions: extracted five AI-interpreted procedures to deterministic scripts and consolidated two shared patterns. New scripts: skills/git-sync-features/scripts/sync-features.ps1 (whole-skill git sequence), skills/git-merge-feature/scripts/merge-feature.ps1 (rebase + ff-merge + delete), scripts/git/rebase-onto-dev.ps1 (shared rebase helper called by both), skills/dt-app-launcher/scripts/verify-launcher.ps1 (Edge hardening + .lnk target verification, replaces hand-interpreted bullet checklist; dt-app-launcher bumped 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0), skills/dt-writing-edit/scripts/next-edit-version.ps1 (deterministic edit-version filename resolution), skills/dt-handoff/scripts/prep-handoff-folder.ps1 (folder prep + existing-file listing + canonical save-paths). New references: references/voice-load-order.md (canonical three-layer voice-reference load order, replaces inline restatement in dt-writing-draft + dt-writing-edit). Consolidated references/conventions.md with the output-paths convention (bare absolute paths, no computer:// links), pointer-swapped from dt-writing-draft, dt-writing-edit, dt-plan (1.0.1 -> 1.0.2), and dt-visualize-plan (1.0.1 -> 1.0.2). No visibility/frontmatter changes.

0.9.17 dt-build-skill-propagation-gate: dt-build (v2.2.0) now runs a final-gate skill-junction reconciler whenever the built repo is danny-skills. The new repo-level scripts\verify-skill-junctions.ps1 diffs skills/ between the merge base and the build branch, materializes per-skill directory junctions across $CODEX_HOME\skills, ~\.agents\skills, D:\Claude\skills, and _Claude-Workspace\.claude\skills, and hard-fails the build on any missing/wrong-target/setup-gap/orphan result. Same script is callable ad-hoc as a one-shot sweep. Closes the recurring invisible-new-skill gap that hid dt-app-launcher from Codex and dt-prototype from two of the four CLI surfaces until the 2026-05-26 manual backfill.
